department: Department of Physics and Atmospheric Science

deadline.value: Formal application: April 1 for non-Canadian applicants for September admission (FGS general deadline; Canadians June 1). Free department pre-application first, reviewed September 1 to April 30, so start well before. Year inferred for September 2027.
deadline.quote: For September admission: | June 1 (Canadian applicants), April 1 (non-Canadian applicants)

also.quote: Pre-applications are reviewed from September 1 to April 30. | Formal application deadlines are set by the Faculty of Graduate Studies and are earlier for international applicants

app_fee.value: CAD 115 for the formal FGS application (the department pre-application is free)
app_fee.quote: To apply, complete the online application form and pay the $115 application fee.

also.quote: There is an application fee for this step.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.quote: No GRE: you don't need to take the GRE (Graduate Record Examination).

gre_physics.value: GRE not required (no subject-test requirement listed)
gre_physics.quote: No GRE: you don't need to take the GRE (Graduate Record Examination).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 92 (tests before Jan 21, 2026); 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale for later tests; IELTS 7
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken before January 21, 2026 | Minimum acceptable score: 92 | For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, only the 1-6 score scale* is considered: Overall score of at least 4.5. | IELTS (Academic, in-person and online) | Minimum acceptable score: 7

english_waiver.value: Waiver can be requested (not automatic) if your degree is from a recognized university with English as the language of instruction in a country where English is an official language; English is an official language of India, but confirm the waiver with the program
english_waiver.quote: It is possible to have this requirement waived if you completed your degree at a recognized university where the language of instruction is English and in a country where English is one of the official languages. You will be able to request this waiver during the application process.

supervisor.value: Admission depends on finding a supervisor through the free pre-application/interview; the formal application is submitted only with a supervisor's support and names the supervisor
supervisor.quote: In our MSc and PhD programs, you do your research with a faculty supervisor, so admission depends on finding one. | With a supervisor's support, you then submit a formal application to Dalhousie through the Faculty of Graduate Studies.

funding.value: Every full-time MSc/PhD student funded; for students of primary-appointment faculty, guaranteed at least CAD 2,000/month take-home on average (CAD 24,000/yr after tuition) and CAD 33,000/yr total; PhD support normally 4 years; internationals funded on the same terms
funding.quote: All full-time students in our MSc and PhD programs, in both Physics and Medical Physics, receive financial support. | For students supervised by faculty with a primary appointment in the Department, in either program, we guarantee: | at least $2,000 per month take-home on average ($24,000 per year), after tuition;

also.quote: Funding: you're funded like everyone else. Every full-time graduate student receives financial support, whatever their citizenship

entry_route.value: PhD normally after a thesis-based master's, but Physics allows direct entry from a bachelor's with supervisor agreement (typically 5 years, 7 courses); MSc-to-PhD transfer after year 1
entry_route.quote: PhD: a thesis-based master's degree. You can also go directly from a bachelor's degree to the PhD, with your supervisor's agreement.

also.quote: In Physics, you can also enter the PhD directly from a bachelor's degree

notes: Apply via a free department pre-application first; a professor interviews you and funding is fixed before the formal FGS application. International PhD tuition equals domestic. Department Graduate Scholarship (CAD 20,000/yr, GPA 3.7+) open to internationals.
